{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|And judging from the cloak we found, you are a Kaleesh General, are you not?|San Hill, to Grievous|<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution">{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>}}
[[File:Grievous_original.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Grievous, a Kaleesh, wore a Kaleesh cloak during the Huk War before he became a cyborg.]]
A heavy,<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> ragged gouges and tattered campaign '''cloaks'''<ref name="ROTS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> worn by [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] and soldiers and made of [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]] hide<ref name="CSWE" /> native to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]].<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

[[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] wore a striking [[Armorweave/Legends|armorweave]] [[Cape/Legends|cape]] that resembled the basic one he had worn during the [[Huk War]].<ref name="The Story of General Grievous">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> Grievous dressed the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in customary [[Clothing/Legends|headwraps]] and [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] like his [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]] [[Khan/Legends|khans]]. It's unclear if he meant this as a respect to his original elite or as a kind of satire.<ref name="Lord of War" />
